qualifier: damage sensing, end joining and ADP-ribosylation
name: DNA double-strand break sensing, end joining and ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing/ATM signalling, NHEJ and regulation of HR-vs-NHEJ choice, BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects and PARP-type ADP-ribosylation, which the resection/D-loop HR confusables lack.

core: Steroid hormone and vitamin hormone biosynthesis
name: Steroid hormone, vitamin D and retinoic acid metabolism
rationale: Members are largely CYP-driven steroidogenesis (pregnenolone to glucocorticoid, mineralocorticoid, androgen, estrogen) plus vitamin D and retinoic acid synthesis/catabolism; the retinoid and vitamin D arms separate it from steroid/phosphate confusables and steroidogenesis from the vitamin K/retinol confusable.

core: Dendritic cell-driven CD4 T cell activation
qualifier: costimulation and regulatory T cell differentiation
name: Dendritic cell maturation, T cell costimulation and Treg induction
rationale: Members concern dendritic cell differentiation/activation and the TCR-MHC costimulatory activation of CD4 T cells biased toward Treg over Th17, unlike confusables centred on NK cells, tolerance/anergy or negative T cell regulation.

name: SUMOylation of chromatin, cofactor, RNA-binding and repair proteins
rationale: All members are SUMOylation of substrate classes; chromatin organization proteins and transcription cofactors distinguish it from confusables that hold the SUMO conjugation machinery, transcription factors or nuclear envelope substrates.

name: Pancreatic and renal ductal epithelial branching and maturation
rationale: Members describe branching subdivision, epithelial maturation, kidney cell migration and pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineages, distinct from lung, salivary and early pancreatic/endoderm progenitor confusables.

qualifier: aortic and coronary, with cardiac growth
name: Aortic and coronary smooth muscle development and heart growth
rationale: Members concern aortic/coronary vascular smooth muscle differentiation and artery morphogenesis plus positive control of cardiomyocyte growth and sarcomere organization, unlike confusables on cardiomyocyte proliferation/trabeculation or adult VSMC phenotypic switching.

qualifier: LDL/HDL remodeling and triglyceride-rich particle clearance
name: LDL/HDL remodeling and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance
rationale: Members are remodeling of LDL/HDL and clearance of LDL, VLDL and chylomicrons, whereas confusables emphasise chylomicron assembly, lipase complexes and LXR-driven lipogenesis.

name: Copper ion import, detoxification and homeostasis
rationale: All four members concern cellular copper uptake, transport, detoxification and homeostasis, while confusables concern zinc, cadmium, manganese, iron and metallothionein responses.

core: Toll-like receptor sensing of bacterial ligands
name: TLR2/4/5 sensing of bacterial LPS and lipopeptides
rationale: Members cover LPS transfer to CD14, lipoteichoic acid and lipopeptide responses, TLR2 signalling and MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies for TLR2/4 and TLR5, distinct from inflammasome, cytokine-regulation and NOD1/2 confusables.

name: Nicotinate-based NAD+ salvage and NAD+ catabolism
rationale: Members are nicotinate metabolism, pyridine nucleotide salvage and NAD+ catabolism, in contrast to the de novo tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ route and unrelated nucleotide/CoA confusables.

name: SREBP-driven transcription of cholesterol biosynthesis genes
rationale: Members are SREBP activation and signalling, cholesterol homeostasis/biosynthesis upregulation and promoter-motif modules for SREBF targets, unlike confusables on negative cholesterol regulation, ChREBP glucose sensing or ATF6.

name: BAF and CHD/NuRD chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Most members are assembly of BAF (SWI/SNF) variants and CHD/NuRD/ChAHP remodelers, which the histone acetylation and methylation confusables lack.

name: Pluripotency exit and definitive endoderm specification
rationale: Members combine OCT4/SOX2/NANOG pluripotency control, gastrulation EMT, definitive endoderm fate and foregut morphogenesis, distinct from mesoderm/primitive streak, lateral plate and pancreatic lineage confusables.

name: PTEN-AKT signalling and nuclear phosphoinositide regulation
rationale: Members cover PTEN localization/stability, AKT activation and targets, TORC2 and nuclear PIP synthesis with PI5P, while confusables focus on PTEN loss via ceRNAs, PAK-2p34 or inositol pyrophosphates.

name: Adrenergic, cholinergic and adenosine receptor inhibition of cAMP
rationale: Members centre on Gi/z-coupled adrenergic, muscarinic and adenosine receptors that inhibit adenylate cyclase plus cAMP degradation; the cholinergic and adenosine receptors separate it from Gs/PKA-activating and serotonin confusables.

core: Negative regulation of inflammatory cytokine production
name: Suppression of inflammatory cytokine production and IL-10 regulation
rationale: Members are negative regulation of IL-6, IL-1beta, IL-12 and TNF production plus up- and down-regulation of IL-10, distinct from NF-kappaB, T cell and TLR-signalling regulation confusables.

name: Stromal fibroblast matrix and YAP/TAZ mechanoresponsive programme
rationale: Members are ECM, collagen/TGFB, EMT and fibroblast stromal and YAP/TAZ-matricellular modules plus fibroblast proliferation, unlike integrin, fibronectin and cell-migration confusables.

name: Integrin, fibronectin and collagen-receptor matrix interactions
rationale: Members are integrin cell-surface interactions, fibronectin matrix formation, collagen-activated receptor signalling and ECM modules, which elastic-fibre and stromal-programme confusables lack.

name: Endothelial shear-stress sensing and integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion
rationale: Members combine PIEZO1/PECAM1 laminar and oscillatory shear-stress signalling with integrin activation and leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, while confusables cover diapedesis and T cell/neutrophil extravasation without flow sensing.

name: Actin filament polymerization, severing, capping and crosslinking
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, depolymerization, severing, barbed-end capping, Arp2/3 nucleation and crosslinked networks, distinct from lamellipodium, focal adhesion and filopodium confusables.

name: Cohesin-mediated sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading, establishment, centromeric maintenance and resolution of cohesion plus cohesin-dependent chromatin looping, unlike condensation, replication or spindle checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: fibrinolysis and inherited clotting factor defects
name: Coagulation cascade, fibrinolysis and inherited clotting factor defects
rationale: Members are intrinsic/common coagulation, contact activation, fibrinolysis control and F8, F9, FV, VWF, FXII and SERPING1 variant defects, while confusables centre on platelet activation receptors or matrix proteolysis.

name: Rab-GAP and Arf control of endosomal recycling and Golgi
rationale: Members combine Rab GAP/Arf GTPase regulation with endocytic recycling, endosome tubulation and Golgi vesicle budding/localization, which Golgi-organization, retrograde and lysosome-biogenesis confusables lack.

name: AMPA, kainate and NMDA glutamate receptor activation
rationale: Members cover activation, trafficking and signalling of NMDA, AMPA and kainate receptors and LTP; AMPA and kainate receptor activation distinguishes it from NMDAR-to-CREB plasticity confusables.

name: Satellite cell maintenance and inhibition of myogenic differentiation
rationale: Members are muscle stem cell division and maintenance plus negative regulation of myoblast proliferation, differentiation and muscle development, unlike confusables on myoblast fusion, migration or atrophy.
